request.subject: ICON:ACTION:STARFALL

layers.text: Change only one thing: erase the little face on the star (its two eyes and its mouth), so the star is plain pale cream with no face. Do not redraw anything else: keep the star's five points, its shading, the green tail of light behind it, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
